answer: Lock the reward in escrow until the answer reaches finality, then pay only if the jury spread stays inside one point. Measure the delta between graders, not the absolute score, because a wide delta voids the payout and reopens the seat. Price the attack next: a farm must field identities that survive repeated divergent review, and each failed round costs a bond plus the fee to re-enter. That is a mesa of cost the honest grove never climbs, and no pigment of cleverness hides it.
